FRAME 4 — THE FIRST MORNING. The Last Bus set, animated-cel register. Master 1640x2048, 4:5 portrait.

SCENE — at Oxford Circus at dawn, looking down the car-free street toward Bell's Umbrellas, the community bus parked at the kerb. OXFORD CIRCUS: the wide crossing at the top of the car-free street, its traffic signals dark, new bollards along the kerb. BELL'S SHOP: the narrow Victorian shopfront of Bell's Umbrellas at the kerb, its deep-red door open. COMMUNITY BUS: the Routemaster parked at the kerb outside Bell's, its rear platform open, a brass tea urn and shelves of books inside. PAVEMENT: the wet pavement between the shop and the bus. DAWN STREET: the empty car-free roadway running away from the camera, wet and lit by a rising sun.

STAGING — Void: stands perfectly still in the open street between Wyatt and Lucy, fully visible from head to feet, clear of the figures in front: an ordinary adult height of 165cm, the same height as Lucy; a solid black body with the build of a slim adult, a rounded torso, hips, thighs and calves; thick rubberhose arms hanging at its sides; a large round black sphere for a head; flat oval feet; a plain featureless surface and a short narrow neck; standing perfectly still and silent [OXFORD CIRCUS — in the open street between Wyatt and Lucy, a few steps ahead of the shop; gaze on the dawn, past everyone]

STAGING — the Conductor: lies collapsed where it stands revealed — the black conductor's coat and white gloves heaped on the wet pavement, an empty costume; the porcelain mask sits out of frame beyond the edge [OXFORD CIRCUS — collapsed heap on the pavement; gaze on the costume's empty interior of cloth]

STAGING — Wyatt, in the black cardigan, white t-shirt, black cargo trousers and black wool overcoat; never the black tee, black jeans and black wool overcoat; never the navy work apron over cream blouse and charcoal skirt: holds the black peaked cap HIGH in his raised right hand, his left hand loose at his side; his own black mask still on — the masked man holding the fake's cap [OXFORD CIRCUS — frame-left of Void; gaze on Void]

STAGING — Lucy, in the black tee, black jeans and black wool overcoat; never the black cardigan, white t-shirt, black cargo trousers and black wool overcoat; never the navy work apron over cream blouse and charcoal skirt: stands in the open street in profile, her face turned toward Void and away from the camera, her expression serious; the punched ticket is held up in her right hand, her left hand at her side; her black coat open; her wavy shoulder-length hair and gold hoop earrings catch the dawn, her throat bare [OXFORD CIRCUS — foreground, in the open street a few steps from Void; gaze on Void]

STAGING — Cyndi: sits on the community bus's rear platform beside a brass tea urn, front paws together, tail sweeping the boards, ears up; she looks at Ada [COMMUNITY BUS — low, on the bus's rear platform; gaze on Ada]

STAGING — Ada Bell, in the navy work apron over cream blouse and charcoal skirt; never the black cardigan, white t-shirt, black cargo trousers and black wool overcoat; never the black tee, black jeans and black wool overcoat: stands at the community bus's rear platform with both hands clutching the red ledger to her chest, her chin up, her spectacles catching the dawn; the shop door is behind her; she looks at Void [COMMUNITY BUS — at the community bus's open rear platform, beside Cyndi; gaze on Void]

PROP — routemaster: the same 1956 Routemaster, deep bus red, the rear destination blind replaced by a plain black metal plate, warm amber interior; the rear platform open; a brass tea urn and a shelf of books inside; a small brass hand bell on the counter; the bus is a community bus now, its surfaces plain [owner: Ada Bell; anchor: COMMUNITY BUS]

STATE — routemaster: the bus is stationary and safe; the engine is off; the interior lights are warm; the bus is a solid community bus standing on its wheels; its destination plate is plain black

PROP — peaked cap: the Conductor's black peaked cap with a polished patent visor and a blank oval badge [owner: Wyatt; anchor: OXFORD CIRCUS]

PROP — red ledger: the thick red leather ledger with a brass clasp and a tiny embossed bell; pages blank [owner: Ada Bell; anchor: COMMUNITY BUS]

STATE — red ledger: the ledger is Ada's evidence; it is in her hands

PROP — punched ticket: the stiff card bus ticket with a single clean circular punch hole [owner: Lucy; anchor: OXFORD CIRCUS]

MOMENT — The unmasking at dawn on the first morning the street belongs to people: the costume is empty, Void stands revealed, Wyatt holds the cap high, Ada holds the ledger, and the community bus waits outside Bell's. The first pedestrians are already on the pavement, keeping their distance.

ENVIRONMENT INVENTORY: Oxford Circus at dawn: the car-free street wet and empty of traffic, the traffic signals dark, new bollards along the kerb, the department-store windows lit but quiet, Bell's Umbrellas' deep-red door open, the Routemaster parked at the kerb with its rear platform open, a brass tea urn and shelves of books inside, steam rising; the first pedestrians — a nurse in scrubs, a cleaner with a mop, a cyclist walking a bike, a dog walker — small in the background, shapes only, every surface plain and unlettered, blank hoardings.

LIGHTING: rose-gold dawn from the east down the empty street, sodium lamps fading, the bus's warm amber interior, long shadows and wet reflections; Void a flat black silhouette, crisp against the dawn; the brass cap badge and the red ledger catching the first light.

COLOUR: full colour — rose dawn, charcoal wet asphalt, deep bus red, warm amber; Akane's deep-red scarf and the red ledger the only other reds; Void pure flat black.

NEGATIVES: destination blinds, tickets, the ledger, shop signs, badges and book spines are plain blank panels of colour; the street is in full colour throughout the frame, right up to Void's silhouette; Void stands upright, free and whole; the Conductor's costume lies collapsed and empty on the ground, the coat folded in on itself and the mask detached; the Routemaster is a solid community bus standing on its wheels, painted opaque; a calm aftermath: everyone whole, free and unhurt, with clean costumes and undamaged props; Wyatt's hands are clean bare skin, his only tattoos the king and queen on his neck; Wyatt's mask is a smooth matte-black shield covering his whole face from hairline to chin, its surface plain black with two round eye holes; Lucy has wavy shoulder-length hair and gold hoop earrings; Lucy's face is turned to Void, her expression intent; the bus's destination plate is plain black; Cyndi is a tan Belgian Malinois-type shepherd with a black muzzle, erect ears, dark eyes, a lean athletic build and a short coat; Ada Bell is a 78-year-old adult woman standing upright, with a compact sturdy build; Void is a 165cm rubberhose figure: a solid black body with the mass of a slim adult, a round sphere for a head proportionate to his body, thick flexible hose arms, a short narrow neck and flat oval feet; Void has a solid black body with real volume, rounded and sculptural in three dimensions; Void stands shorter than the bus, which is the tallest object in the frame; Void is a separate living figure standing between Wyatt and Lucy, his own body distinct from the collapsed costume; the tea urn and books sit inside the community bus, and the shop window behind them shows bare glass; the book spines are blank coloured cloth; the shop fascia is plain dark red paint.

VOID (verbatim block): Void is a 1930s rubberhose cartoon character rendered as a slim humanoid silhouette in flat, pure matte black, with a perfectly round ball head — a clean black circle from every angle — whose diameter is one fifth of its total height. Its head carries one smooth unbroken black surface: a blank face, plain and unornamented, and that same flat matte black continues over its whole body as a single textureless surface. Its neck is short and narrow. Its arms and legs are jointless rubber hoses of NORMAL human length that hang in smooth continuous curves, all elbowless and kneeless, curving rather than angling; its hands reach mid-thigh and end in simple black four-fingered hose hands, with large rounded bulbous black rubberhose shoe-feet below. Void stands upright and motionless, still and unbending — a rubberhose character that keeps perfectly still; its stillness is its threat.

THE CONDUCTOR (verbatim block): The Conductor is a tall, narrow figure about 196cm high: a black London Transport bus conductor's double-breasted coat with silver buttons, a high collar and long skirts to the ankle; a white shirt and black tie; black trousers with a thin red side stripe; raised black leather boots; white cotton gloves; and a tall black peaked cap with a polished patent visor and a blank oval badge. The face is a smooth porcelain oval mask the colour of a blank ticket, its only opening a single clean circular punch hole where the mouth would sit, and its surface blank ticket-white everywhere beyond that — plainly a theatrical costume mask. A heavy brass ticket punch hangs from a chain at the belt. It is a person in a bus conductor's costume: a solid figure standing on its own feet, the coat dense opaque wool, dressed for a harmless theatrical fright. IN THIS FRAME ONLY: the costume is off its wearer — the black conductor's coat and white gloves lie collapsed on the wet pavement; the porcelain mask sits out of frame, hidden from view; the peaked cap is held high in Wyatt's right hand; Void stands revealed at his true height.

WYATT (verbatim block): Wyatt is an adult man in flat painterly cel animation, drawn EXACTLY as in his cel reference sheet — the same man. He is 153cm tall and exactly 5 heads in proportion: his head, hair and mask together are one fifth of his height, with a grown man's construction throughout and legs about half his height. His hair is voluminous black curls, medium length. On his neck sit two portrait tattoos facing inward toward the throat: a crowned bearded KING on his left side, and a crowned QUEEN — a woman — on his right.

WYATT'S MASK (verbatim, mandatory): The mask is a tall smooth shield of matte black covering his whole face in one piece, from the hairline above his brow down past his jaw and chin, edge to edge across both cheeks. Its surface is plain matte black throughout. It carries two round holes, one at each eye, and those two holes are its only openings: each one opens onto flat empty blackness. The mask reads as a single unbroken black form from forehead to chin, with both round eye holes always present and open.

WYATT'S OUTFIT — wyatt.oxford_night: a black knit button cardigan (5 buttons, patch pockets) worn open over a plain white crew-neck t-shirt; black cargo trousers with side flap pockets; a black wool overcoat worn open over the cardigan; black Adidas Samba sneakers with white side stripes, gum-brown soles and a small blue heel tab.

LUCY (verbatim block): Lucy is a Puerto Rican woman with a wide, slightly flattened oval face, a defined angular jawline softer at the cheeks, a light dusting of freckles across her nose and cheeks, and skin in a light warm tan. Her eyes are large vertical ovals with green irises and a heavy lower lash line: the lid line sweeps smoothly from inner to outer corner, and each iris fills its opening with clear green. She is 5 feet 4 inches tall with a very slim, willowy build — narrow shoulders and ribcage, a small waist, slim hips, thin arms and long legs (inseam about 48% of her height, natural waist at about 60%) — and a full, generous F bust. Her hair is long loose waves to mid-back, centre-parted, black with graphic sculptural clumps. Everything she wears is black and white; coral is her design signature — it lives in her work as ink and paper, while her skin and face stay clean, bare and untouched.

LUCY'S OUTFIT — lucy.oxford_night: a plain black t-shirt tucked into black jeans, a black wool overcoat worn open, white socks, plain black leather loafers, her two gold hoop earrings.

CYNDI (verbatim block): Cyndi is a lean, athletic medium-sized mixed-breed dog with a short uniform golden-tan coat, a long muzzle that is BLACK with a little grey around the mouth, large upright pointed ears with dark backs, dark brown eyes, a small white patch on her chest and white tips on her paws, and a straight medium-length tail carried low with a dark tip. Her build is that of a grown athletic mixed breed with normal leg length for her size: a long straight tail, a lean foxy muzzle and a short smooth coat, exactly the adult dog shown in her attached reference images.

ADA BELL (verbatim block): Ada Bell is a 78-year-old London shopkeeper, 160cm tall, with a compact, sturdy upright build and a spry, robust carriage: silver-white hair pinned in a low bun, deep laugh lines, sharp dark eyes behind brass-rimmed half-moon spectacles, a straight nose, and a small mole on her left cheek. Her hands are square and capable, with short clean nails and a faint ink stain on her right forefinger. She reads as a human woman of seventy-eight with an adult's proportions, standing tall and straight.

ADA BELL'S OUTFIT — ada.workwear: a navy-blue cotton work apron with a breast pocket over a cream blouse with rolled sleeves and a charcoal wool skirt; brown lace-up shoes; brass-rimmed half-moon spectacles; a red enamel thimble on a chain at her neck; a cloth tape measure around her neck.

SCALE: Void is 165cm — the tallest in this frame; Lucy (163cm), Ada Bell (160cm), Wyatt (153cm), Cyndi (58cm).

The black cardigan, white t-shirt, black cargo trousers and black wool overcoat appears exactly once in this frame, on Wyatt.

The black tee, black jeans and black wool overcoat appears exactly once in this frame, on Lucy.

The navy work apron over cream blouse and charcoal skirt appears exactly once in this frame, on Ada Bell.

RENDER GRADE — ANIMATED (verbatim in every frame): Flat painterly cel animation — bold clean ink outlines, flat colour fills with soft cel shading, the look of a hand-drawn animated feature film: a classic cartoon mystery adventure retold as an animated film still. Cinematic composition, dramatic motivated lighting rendered in cel tones. 4:5 portrait composition. Absolutely no text, no lettering, no captions, no logos and no watermark anywhere in the image.
